children: The following is a range of analysts' estimates of ethanol production and ethanol inventories for the week ended Sept. 11. Production units are in thousands of barrels per day, while inventories are listed in thousands of barrels. Parentheses indicate a negative number. The report is scheduled to be released at 10:30 a.m. ET Wednesday by the EIA.

Estimates         Actuals 
                       Sep 11       Sep 4    Aug 28 
PRODUCTION (t/bl)   1,080-1,104     1,099    1,110 
STOCKS (t/bl)      24,500-25,400   25,187   25,035
